name: KFD-NeRF
aliases: Kalman Filter Guided Deformation Field NeRF
definition: A dynamic NeRF method that uses a Kalman filter to guide motion prediction, combining an MLP-based observer (for direct observation) and a system-dynamics-based predictor (for history-based prediction) to estimate deformation fields.
summary: KFD-NeRF is a dynamic NeRF method that uses a Kalman filter to fuse motion observations and predictions, employing a tri-plane representation for faster convergence and lower memory usage.
